holder-quote: Ceria pointed at the adventurers fighting with the Frostmarrow Behemoth. She turned, and the breaking walls of ice holding off Draugr refroze. Pisces looked at her.
effect-quote: She saw him hesitate. Then the [Necromancer] nodded. He began to run, [Flash Stepping] across the street. He vanished, heading towards the first Skeleton Lord. Ceria exhaled.

holder-quote: Then Pisces was [Flash Stepping] away, firing [Deathbolts]
Colth hurtled onto the decks and saw Pisces [Flash Stepping] backwards
Pisces was [Flash Stepping] left as Ceria’s magic swirled around her.
